transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Could you tell me what’s been troubling you that brought you here today?

Well, I'm here because my family thinks I'm doing too much. They keep telling me to slow down, but honestly, it just feels like I'm the only one with enough drive to actually get things done. We're in the middle of a move, and I'm handling all of that. Plus, I'm planning to rebuild the new garage the right way, I've been organizing a bunch of things over at the church, and I'm still working—showing the younger guys at the blending plant how the job is actually supposed to be done. I just have a lot of energy right now and a lot to accomplish, but everyone else seems to think it's a problem.
Have you had any distinct period recently where your mood was unusually high, irritable, or you felt more energetic than usual—like you didn’t need much sleep or couldn’t slow down?

Well, I guess you could say my mood's been... big. I just feel like everybody needs to either get on board with my plans or get out of my way. One minute I'm joking around, feeling ten feet tall and ready to take on the world, and the next... well, I might snap at my wife or my boy over some little question they ask. It just feels like they're dragging their feet when I'm trying to move forward.
Have you had a period where your mood was elevated or irritable for at least several days in a row—like a full week or more—where it was a noticeable change from your usual self?
Yeah, it's been longer than a week. I'd say this has been going on for about a month now. Pretty much ever since we were forced to start leaving the old house.
During this time when you've felt more energetic and your mood has been elevated or irritable, have you found that you needed less sleep than usual?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean... my sleep has been about the same as it always is. I haven't really noticed needing less of it, to be honest. I just get my regular rest and then get up to handle what needs doing.

Have you found yourself doing things that were unusual for you—like spending a lot of money, taking on big projects without thinking them through, or acting in ways that others might see as reckless or impulsive?

Yeah, I have. I actually... well, I went and put some deposits down on some garage work and new equipment recently, and I didn't talk it over with my wife first. I've also just been driving back and forth between the houses a lot. And at the plant, I've been rushing through my jobs. People warned me I was taking chances, moving like that and rushing the work, but I just kept right on doing it anyway.

So you mentioned this has been going on for about a month—can you clarify if there has been a full 7-day period or more where you felt this way most of the day, nearly every day, and it was clearly different from how you usually feel?

Yeah, it's definitely been more than a week. Like I said, it's been about a month straight of feeling this way. It's pretty much all day, every day. And it's definitely different from my normal self. I'm usually pretty level-headed, but lately I just... I can't seem to slow down.
